title: id24 shared resources
description: Created by id Software, this resource pack contains essential graphic and definition assets for mods built using the ID24 standard. It features new monsters such as the Ghoul, Banshee, Mindweaver, Shocktrooper, Vassago, and Tyrant, alongside various decorative props. These resources were first utilized in the Legacy of Rust episode.
notes: Imported from an owned GOG release of Doom + Doom II (id24res.wad).
